title: Certificates of Deposit: was the relationship bonus earned at the term's start, for a penalty check?
content:
## Scope

When an early withdrawal penalty on a Certificates of Deposit certificate is checked against the rate the charter fixes for the term, the relationship bonus belongs in that rate only if the owner earned it at the term's start. This rule decides that question from the owner's checking accounts.

## Rule

1. The tier's relationship bonus points are added when the owner held, on the term start date, a checking account of a tier listed among the certificate tier's qualifying checking tiers.
2. "Held on the term start date" means an account opened on or before the term start date and not closed before it, judged from that checking account's tier, opened date and closed date; for a closed account this means its closing date is later than the term start date.
3. Both the owner's active checking account and the owner's closed checking account are checked; one qualifying account is enough.
4. A relationship bonus earned at the term's start stays in the rate for the whole term, even when that checking account is closed later.

## How each checking account is judged

| Account | Tier is a qualifying checking tier | Opened on or before the term start date | Closing date | Counts as held on the term start date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The owner's active checking account | Required | Required | Not closed | Yes, when both requirements are met |
| The owner's closed checking account | Required | Required | Later than the term start date | Yes, when all three are met |
| The owner's closed checking account | Required | Required | Before the term start date | No |

## Cases (hypothetical dates; the certificate's term starts 1 April)

| Owner's checking accounts | Relationship bonus earned at the term's start? |
|---|---|
| Active account of a qualifying tier, opened 15 January | Yes |
| Active account of a qualifying tier, opened 2 April | No, opened after the term start date |
| Active account of a non-qualifying tier; closed account of a qualifying tier opened 1 March and closed 20 May | Yes, the closed account was held on 1 April |
| Closed account of a qualifying tier, opened 1 March and closed 25 March; no active checking account | No, it was closed before the term start date |

## Points of judgement

**The owner closed the qualifying checking account halfway through the term. Is the bonus taken out of the rate the charter fixes?**
No. A bonus earned at the term's start stays in the rate for the whole term.

**The certificate is not marked as carrying the relationship bonus, but the owner did hold a qualifying account on the term start date. What counts?**
Whether the owner held the qualifying account on the term start date. That, not the marker, decides whether the relationship bonus points belong in the rate the charter fixes.
